boundary: Actual Update, HasField wrappers/inner, GetNumberField, six type virtual slots and String IsNumeric executed offline. Controlled map lookup, allocation/construction/set/free/diagnostic helpers; CRT calls into same local ucrtbase file and exported symbol RVA, no calls into game.
